sc2_join_debate.text: A flyer on the hallway wall says the debate club needs bodies. The teacher in charge promises free pizza and the chance to be right out loud.

sc2_debate_tournament.text: Regional debate tournament. You draw the side you disagree with. The judge looks tired and unimpressed.

outcomes.win: You dismantle the other team with a smile. A trophy appears in your hands.
outcomes.lose: You lose on a technicality. You were right, which helps nobody.

sc2_join_drama.text: The drama club is holding open auditions for the spring show. Half the school hums show tunes, quietly.

sc2_drama_lead.text: The director posts the cast list. Your name is either at the top or in tiny print near the bottom.

outcomes.lead: You get the lead. You forget your lines once and the audience cries anyway.
outcomes.chorus: You're Third Villager. Third Villager steals the show, in your own mind.

sc2_join_robotics.text: The robotics club builds a machine that must pick up foam cubes. Nobody has slept well since October.

sc2_robot_comp.text: Competition day. The robot has one job and one flaw: it hates the left side of the table.

outcomes.win: The robot grabs every cube. The team screams in a parking-lot sort of way.
outcomes.smoke: Something sparks. The robot goes up in smoke, taking your Saturdays with it.

sc2_football_tryout.text: Football tryouts. The coach reads names off a clipboard like a judge reading verdicts.

outcomes.made: Your name is on the list. You get a jersey that smells like old tape.
outcomes.cut: Cut. The coach says 'maybe next year' without making eye contact.

sc2_football_game.text: Friday night game. Fourth quarter, tied, and the coach points at you.

outcomes.hero: You make the play of your life. The bleachers chant a name that is yours.
outcomes.fumble: You fumble. A parent in the third row has opinions about it for years.
outcomes.injury: You go down hard. The ankle swells to the size of a plum.

sc2_swim_tryout.text: Swim team tryouts at dawn. The pool smells like chlorine and ambition.

outcomes.made: You make the team. Your hair will be green by June.
outcomes.cut: You don't make it. You swim home in spirit.

sc2_swim_meet.text: The relay anchor is out sick. The coach looks down the line and lands on you.

outcomes.win: You touch the wall first. Water in your ears, glory in your chest.
outcomes.dq: You jump early. Disqualified. The team forgives you in about a week.

sc2_join_chess.text: Chess club meets in the library at lunch. Nobody talks, and somehow it is still the loudest room in school.

sc2_chess_match.text: Inter-school chess match. Your opponent is eleven and eats an apple like a threat.

outcomes.win: Checkmate in 22 moves. The kid finishes his apple and shakes your hand.
outcomes.lose: He sacrifices a queen and wins anyway. You respect it a little.

sc2_join_band.text: The school band needs a few more players before the winter show. Instruments are lent out for free, with a lecture attached.

sc2_band_concert.text: The winter concert. Your section starts a bar early and nobody knows who to blame.

sc2_rival_appears.text: A classmate keeps matching your every score, your every joke, and your haircut. You've decided they're a rival.

outcomes.ahead: You edge ahead by two points. It feels like a coronation.
outcomes.behind: They edge past you. You file a grudge, neatly labelled.

sc2_rival_showdown.text: The rival again. A class contest, one winner, no refunds. They offer a handshake with too many fingers in it.

outcomes.win: You win fair and square. They nod. It's almost warm.
outcomes.lose: They win. You congratulate them with exactly one muscle in your face.

sc2_popular_clique.text: The popular group invites you to their lunch table. The invitation comes with a quick look at your shoes.

sc2_unpopular_day.text: A rumour about you is making the rounds. It's completely wrong, but better written than the truth.

sc2_believing_teacher.text: A teacher stays after class to tell you that you're capable of more, and that they're going to be annoying about it.

sc2_substitute_chaos.text: A substitute teacher walks in with a cheerful voice and no seating chart. The class smells blood.

outcomes.fun: The sub spends all period calling the wrong person. It's the best hour of the term.
outcomes.busted: She was a teacher for twenty years. She sees through you, then gives you extra work.

sc2_detention_hall.text: Detention. An hour in a quiet room with a clock that clearly runs slow.

choices.talk: Whisper with the guy beside you

sc2_cheating_ring.text: A group sells quiz answers in the bathroom. It's organised, quiet, and cheaper than a tutor.

outcomes.pass: The answers work. Your conscience goes quiet and sticks around.
outcomes.caught: The principal busts the ring. Your name is on the list. Suspension.

sc2_school_dance.text: The school dance. The gym is dim, the music is loud, and everyone's pressed against the wall like paint.

sc2_yearbook_committee.text: The yearbook needs a photo editor. It also needs people to say no to the wrong photos, which is where you come in.

sc2_yearbook_quote.text: Time to choose your senior yearbook quote. It will live in print forever, next to a photo where your eyes are closed.

sc2_trip_abroad.text: The school announces a trip abroad. It's eight hundred dollars and nine days of supervised adventure.

sc2_trip_passport.text: At the airport you open your bag and your passport is not in it. The teacher has a lanyard and a deep sigh.

outcomes.found: It was in your jacket. The whole group claps ironically.
outcomes.lost: Not found. A rushed replacement costs you and the trip starts a day late.

sc2_science_fair_win.text: Your science fair project works. The judge squints at it, then at you, then writes something down.

outcomes.win: First prize. A ribbon, a handshake, and a photo in the local paper.
outcomes.honorable: Honorable mention. You get a small ribbon and an enormous amount of pride.

sc2_fight_hallway.text: Someone shoves you in the hallway and a crowd forms before you can blink. Phones come out.

outcomes.win: You land one. A teacher lands you in the office. Suspended.
outcomes.lose: You lose, loudly. The suspension arrives with a pamphlet.
outcomes.pulled: A teacher pulls you both apart. Everyone gets the same punishment.

sc2_crush_class.text: There's someone in the third row whose handwriting you've started to study. It's embarrassing and entirely involuntary.

sc2_crush_note.text: You write a note to your crush and fold it into a triangle. Someone has to deliver it, and you cannot be that person.

outcomes.smile: They read it, glance up, and smile. Your face enters a new colour.
outcomes.read_aloud: The note gets read aloud. You decide to become a different person.
outcomes.no: They hand it back, politely. Somehow worse.

sc2_lunch_extortion.text: An older kid taxes you every day for the 'protection fee': your lunch money. The price keeps rising.

outcomes.respect: They blink first. The tax collector finds someone else.
outcomes.bruised: It goes badly. You lose lunch and some dignity.

sc2_nurse_visit.text: You feel dizzy in math and ask for the nurse. The nurse has seen things and doesn't blink.

sc2_vision_screening.text: Vision screening day. The chart looks like a deranged ladder. You squint like a legal professional.

outcomes.pass: You guess the right letters out of sheer will.
outcomes.glasses: The nurse sends a note home. You need glasses. The world gets sharper.

sc2_spelling_bee_final.text: Spelling bee finals. The word is 'chrysanthemum', and the room is quiet enough to hear a pen drop.

outcomes.right: Every letter lands. You win a trophy shaped like a tiny trumpet.
outcomes.wrong: You miss an 'h' and the bell rings. You will hear that bell forever.

sc2_class_president.text: Elections for class president. Posters are up. One of them uses your photo without permission.

outcomes.win: You win by eleven votes. You immediately start making promises you can't keep.
outcomes.lose: You lose. The winner promises a vending machine, which is the real campaign.

sc2_president_duty.text: As class president you must decide the theme of the spring fair. Six hundred opinions arrive in nine minutes.

sc2_strike_day.text: The teachers' union goes on strike and the school locks its doors. Parents groan. You gain a Tuesday.

sc2_snow_day.text: You wake up to a white world and a school closure announcement. Your parents say 'do not go outside' in the same breath as 'go outside'.

sc2_graduation_rehearsal.text: Graduation rehearsal. The principal reads names while chairs wobble and everyone hums a half-remembered anthem.

sc2_scholarship_interview.text: A foundation interviews you for a scholarship. The panel has three people and a plate of untouched fruit.

outcomes.win: They shake your hand and say the word 'full'. It's the best word you've ever heard.
outcomes.wait: The panel thanks you politely and does not call back.

sc2_show_and_tell.text: It's show and tell. You brought something from home that might be alive, probably not allowed, and certainly a hit.

sc2_recess_game.text: At recess a game of tag turns into a game with rules nobody understands and everybody follows.

sc2_school_bus_seat.text: The back of the school bus is a political zone. You step on and everyone watches you choose.

sc2_pep_rally.text: The school holds a pep rally. A mascot costume is warm and smells of other people's effort.

sc2_field_day.text: Field day. The sack race is between you and a kid who has clearly been training in private.

outcomes.win: You hop to victory. A sticker and a bottle of water are the prizes.
outcomes.fall: You fall face-first into the grass. Everyone cheers anyway.

sc2_book_report.text: The book report is due tomorrow and you've read the cover and a review you found upside-down.

sc2_hall_pass.text: You discover that a hall pass is invisible armor. Nobody questions a person with a laminated card.

sc2_dress_code.text: The vice principal sends you home to change your shirt. The shirt has a pun. The pun was the problem.

sc2_fundraiser_candy.text: You get a box of chocolate bars to sell for the school. The box is heavier than you thought and so is your conscience.

outcomes.sold: You sell every bar. A woman gives you a tip and a hug.
outcomes.stuck: You sell three and eat the rest. Your stomach files a complaint.

sc2_exchange_student.text: An exchange student joins your class. Her accent is a mystery and her sandwich is a delight.

sc2_lab_partner.text: Your lab partner is either a genius or a hazard. Possibly both, since the beaker is smoking.

outcomes.great: The experiment works perfectly. You nod like you planned it.
outcomes.mess: A yellow cloud fills the room. The class is evacuated for lunch.

sc2_college_fair.text: The college fair fills the gym with banners and promises. A recruiter hands you a pen you didn't want to keep.

sc2_senior_prank.text: Senior prank week. Somebody wants to fill the principal's office with balloons and needs someone to hold a door.

outcomes.legend: The office is a sea of balloons. Your class remembers it forever.
outcomes.caught: The principal arrives mid-prank. Cleanup duty and a suspended send-off.

sc2_tutoring_kid.text: The school offers volunteer tutoring hours for younger kids. You'd get service credit and, apparently, a gold star.
